business_summary.text: Apollo Micro Systems designs, develops and manufactures high-performance mission-critical defence electronics, weapon system sub-systems, and explosives.

call_points.text: Management reiterated robust growth expectations for the financial year.
Management reiterated 40-45% growth for this financial year on both consolidated and standalone bases.
No EBITDA margin guidance; management said it does not give EBITDA guidance and only the topline guidance stands.
Unit III first phase production has started; full production expected before March 2027, after which exports will be accepted.
Promoter pledge reduction to zero will take another year, targeted by Q1FY28.
Ideal Explosives was PAT positive in Q1 but with very low profitability; management expects it fully positive from next financial year.
Export revenue is currently nil; management expects meaningful export orders only next financial year, and they are excluded from the growth guidance.
Order book stood at ₹1,432 crores as of March 31, 2026, providing strong visibility for future growth.

operating_notes.text: Company received orders worth ₹51.03 Cr in the ordinary course of business from Ministry of Defence, PSUs, and private companies.
Company utilized ₹619.93 Cr out of ₹742.25 Cr raised in preferential issue up to Q4 FY26.
FY26 revenue reached ₹904.32 Cr and PAT reached ₹107.38 Cr with an order book of ₹1,432 Cr.
Company aims to transition from a Tier-2 supplier to a global defense platform OEM by FY2036.
R&D expenditure for FY26 amounted to 8% of revenue, around ₹72 crores.
Consolidated order book of ₹1,704 Cr as of 8 August 2026 includes ₹480 Cr at Ideal Explosives; standalone order book is ₹1,224 Cr.
Apollo supplies about 5 sub-systems for QRSAM worth more than ₹1 Cr per missile, and components worth about ₹85 lakh per Pinaka.
FY26 R&D spend was ₹72.53 Cr on revenue of ₹764 Cr, about 9.5%; export revenue is currently nil.
IDL Explosives commissioned the 9,000 MT Bolkunda Silo Unit near Asansol, West Bengal to serve Eastern Coalfields and Central Coalfields.
Order book reached ₹1,765 Cr as of 30th September 2026.

timeline.summary: Apollo Micro Systems bagged orders worth ₹51.03 Cr from the Ministry of Defence, public sector units, and private clients.
Apollo Micro Systems allotted 13,000 equity shares on conversion of warrants, raising ₹0.11 Cr.
Apollo Micro Systems filed its monitoring agency report for Q4FY26 showing ₹619.93 Cr utilized from its preferential issue.
Apollo Micro Systems reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹787.54 Cr and PAT of ₹120.73 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹0.25 per share.
Apollo Micro Systems reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹904.32 Cr and PAT of ₹107.38 Cr with an order book of ₹1,432 Cr.
Apollo Micro Systems issued a shareholder letter detailing its FY26 strategic achievements and 10-year vision to become a global defense OEM.
Mr. Addepalli Krishna Sai Kumar (Whole Time Director-Operations) will appear on NDTV Profit’s *Trending Stocks* at 12:30 PM on May 19, 2026, discussing publicly available information.
Apollo Micro Systems Limited’s **Karunakar Reddy Baddam (Managing Director)** held a conference call on 19th May 2026 discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance.
Mr. Addepalli Krishna Sai Kumar (Whole Time Director-Operations) will appear on *The Market* ET Now on May 20, 2026, at 10:10 AM for a TV interview.
Apollo Micro Systems reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹293 Cr and PAT of ₹37 Cr during its earnings call on May 19, 2026.
Srilakshmi Reddy Vangeti, promoter, declared no indirect share acquisition under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 ending March 31, 2026.
On June 8, 2026, Apollo Micro Systems announced trading approval for 13,000 equity shares issued at ₹114 per share pursuant to warrant conversion.

On 8 August 2026 Apollo Micro Systems held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹251 Cr (+88% YoY), PAT of ₹25 Cr (+43%) and a consolidated order book of ₹1,704 Cr, and reiterating 40-45% growth guidance.
On 22 October 2026, Apollo Micro Systems announced that group company IDL Explosives commissioned the 9,000 MT Bolkunda Silo Unit near Asansol, West Bengal.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹388.15 Cr (+72.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹48.43 Cr (+55.7% YoY).
